request.title: The Cry Hidden in a Cat's Purr
request.provider_topic: Why does a hungry cat's purr sound so urgent?
request.narration: That hungry purr has a cry hidden inside. A purr is not one flat sound. It can carry a low rumble and, sometimes, a higher, cry-like layer. In 2009, researchers recorded purrs from ten cats in two situations: ordinary purring and purring while soliciting food. The solicitation purrs held a pronounced high-frequency peak, averaging about 380 hertz, within a broader purr. Fifty listeners heard both recordings at equal volume. They rated the solicitation purrs as more urgent and less pleasant, even when they did not own cats. So the cry in the purr is real, not a clever plan. It is one more way a cat can get a human to listen.
